app.name: Ledger
app.brief: A precise, dense portfolio app for tracking investments, budgets, and market positions. Dark, technical, fast, green signal.

direction.seed: a precise dense portfolio app for tracking investments budgets and market positions dark technical fast green signal ledger

thesis: The app is a precision instrument: dense information, exact alignment, and no decoration that competes with the data.
summary: A dark cockpit: segmented gauges, uppercase labels, and amber alerts.
signature: A segmented status rail across the top.
treatment: Dark-first, mono labels, compact rows, and a single amber warning color.

why.note: The brief strongly matches Instrument. The layout, type, and surface decisions come from that family rather than from a generic template.

css.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
css.body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
css.numeric: 'SF Mono', 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

principles: Every number has a unit, a time, and a comparison.
avoid: A dashboard with no primary question.
Green and red as the only signal.
signatureMoves: A total that updates in place with tabular figures.
A segmented status rail across the top.
A measurement grid behind the data.
A delta marker that sits on the baseline.

platform.ios: Use a compact navigation title, not a large title. Use SF Mono for numbers and SF Pro for labels. Put filters in the toolbar. Keep rows at 44pt minimum. Use a tab bar only for peers; otherwise use a segmented control. Keep the system back gesture.
platform.android: TopAppBar with title and filter action. Edge-to-edge. Use a compact NavigationBar or rail. No FAB unless there is one dominant create action. Use tabular figures and 48dp rows. Predictive back must work.

screens.home: One dominant total, a compact delta, a status rail, and rows with aligned columns. The total is the only oversized element.
screens.detail: A single position: price, change, position size, cost basis, and a simple chart. Actions sit in the toolbar or at the bottom, not floating.
screens.compose: A transaction form: amount first, then account, category, date, and note. Use a numeric keypad, inline validation, and a visible save state.
screens.profile: Settings and account: grouped rows, clear labels, no invented achievements. Security and data export are easy to find.

components.button: Rectangular with a 0-4pt radius. Primary filled with the signal accent; secondary outlined with a 1pt border. Numeric labels use tabular figures.
components.list: Rows with a 1pt bottom rule, 12-16pt vertical padding, aligned numeric columns, no cards.
components.input: Label above, value right-aligned for numbers, unit inside the field. Error text below in the danger color.
components.navigation: Compact title, filter in the toolbar, tab bar or rail for peers. No hamburger.
